web.orders: the dedicated Order Status Feed socket (createWsToken, then orderToken and userId)

notes: AliceBlue streams five levels; LTP and Quote ride the touchline (t), Depth the depth feed (d), on the Noren socket the web opens after createWsSess.

The web's data dicts carry no symbol, exchange or mode, its ltt and Depth timestamp are AliceBlue's feed time as a string of epoch seconds, and its Quote leaves out the trade quantity and book totals: see each case's deviations.
